Requirements You are wielding a melee weapon with the disarm, shove, or trip trait.

After quickly drawing a rune on your weapon, you can transfer the rune to a foe as you knock them down, push them away, or disarm their weapon. Attempt to [[/act disarm]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] a target; your weapon must have the corresponding trait. If your skill check is successful, you Trace a Rune onto the target of the Strike even if the target is pushed out of range.
